title: Carl Friedrich Gauss: Werke and Individual Papers (Modern LaTeX Working Drafts)
version: 2026-06-04 Gauss Band II cumulative through printed page 303
description:
Author record for Carl Friedrich Gauss in the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page presents selected Werke volumes and individual passages as modern LaTeX working reader PDFs, with source TeX, component PDFs, compile outputs, source references, and audit reports preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Status at a glance.

  • Reader PDFs: [########--] eight broad front-facing readers are present, totaling more than 3,000 pages: Werke Bands I, I alternate, II, III, VI, VII, XI Part I, and an individual-papers grouping.
  • Band II source-checked cumulative: [###-------] this update adds paired original-language and English readers for Werke Band II from the actual beginning through printed page 303, including the start of Theoria residuorum biquadraticorum. Commentatio secunda, Articles 24-29, the accepted forward cumulative material, the first Latin Nachlass section, De nexu [IX]-[X], and Dedekind remarks to De nexu through printed page 303.
  • Current repair incorporation: [#########-] the cumulative rebuild includes repaired and source-checkable supplements for Disquisitiones Arithmeticae gaps, Band I alternate expansion, Band II quadratic reciprocity and Seeber material, Band III AGM formulas, Band VI chapters 8/10/11/13, Band VII chapter/article repairs, and Band XI Part I recovered material.
  • Source artifacts: [########--] TeX sources, component PDFs, compile logs, source-page references, scan witnesses, render images, and audit reports are preserved in artifact ZIPs for inspection and continuation.
  • Proofreading state: [###-------] machine-assisted working drafts needing source comparison, theorem/reference checking, and mathematical proofreading.

Source-quality refresh. A local 2026-06-14 audit found that future Gauss continuation should use the coherent GDZ Werke source PDFs plus IIIF manifests across Bands I-XII as the baseline. Older IA/Rich/Google PDFs and broad old reader PDFs are fallback/provenance unless a specific tranche is re-audited. The old reader PDFs should not be treated as globally completed editions.

Use of this record. The top-level PDFs are intended for direct reading and download. ZIP files are for reconstruction, repair, and provenance. Large raw preservation remains on the main project record rather than being re-uploaded here.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Clean author-facing Gauss record. Latest update adds Band II source-checked cumulative original-language and English readers through printed page 303 plus a compact TeX/source-scan/audit packet, while leaving the large existing source/provenance artifact unchanged. Local 2026-06-14 source-quality audit identifies GDZ Werke PDFs plus IIIF manifests across Bands I-XII as the future source baseline and warns not to treat older broad reader PDFs as globally complete without re-audit.
